integrity: Analytical proof provided; finite verification is supplementary and does not certify infinite parameter claims.
scientific_limitations: Balanced K_{q,q} cores only; uniform strictly positive pendant length; real zero-sum powered-distance forms. No uniqueness of the optimizing pendant length is asserted. Earlier general negative-type and corona results are antecedents, and literature-priority risk remains.
title: Two-sided pendant-length restoration and a singular branching law for bipartite corona roundness
